params.name: id
params.description: A jobId or uuid in STRING format. JobId must be prefixed with `jobId:`(Examples: `"8d218e6c-7a16-4f9f-90f7-cc1d93b9e596"`, `"jobId:98765"`).

params.name: startDate
params.description: A start time in RFC 3339 format. Millisecond precision and timezones are supported. (Examples: 2019-06-13T19:08:25Z, 2019-06-13T19:08:25.455Z, OR 2015-09-15T14:00:12-04:00).

params.name: endDate
params.description: An end time in RFC 3339 format. Millisecond precision and timezones are supported. (Examples: 2019-06-13T19:08:25Z, 2019-06-13T19:08:25.455Z, OR 2015-09-15T14:00:12-04:00).

params.name: status
params.description: A job status in STRING format. Job statuses can be one of three (ignores case): `"active", "scheduled", "completed"`  Valid values: `active`, `scheduled`, `completed`

params.name: after
params.description: If specified, this should be the endCursor value from the previous page of results. When present, this request will return the next page of results that occur immediately after the previous page of results.
